name: modellix-agent-canvas
description: A general-purpose local stdio MCP canvas for Modellix image generation, editing, paid-task recovery, and project-local visual work.

interface.shortDescription: Create and edit images through Modellix in compatible MCP applications.
interface.longDescription: Modellix Agent Canvas is a general-purpose local stdio MCP plugin for compatible AI applications. Codex, Cursor, Claude Code, and OpenCode are verified hosts. Applications with MCP Apps support can embed the Excalidraw-powered canvas; other compatible hosts can use the same tools and the restricted local-web canvas.
defaultPrompt: Open Modellix Agent Canvas for this project.
Generate an image in the selected AI image holder through Modellix.
Apply my canvas annotations through Modellix and place the result beside the original.
